source_commits: 165d6efcd5e43d57593edf72354b235e2e26078a feat(linux): wait for pending signals with timeout and interruption
d963f3339783d88b46f0b14aba51a77f9a82a8ea feat(linux): requeue futex waiters with cancellation-safe cleanup
cecb80942df79b72225a26a9beba7ef33895dfaf feat(vm): grow private anonymous mappings for Linux mremap
6c637b08843f55fb93168ce325e9223c422ad5a4 feat(task): retain entry stack metadata for Linux thread attribute queries

art.launch: stock Android 13 ARM64 ART; image-less -Xint; no JIT; no LD_PRELOAD; no guest Linux kernel
art.stock_linkerconfig: full ART configuration equals stock host reference

resolved_blockers: Bionic main-thread stack attributes required getrlimit and proc stat initial SP
Bionic atexit array required private anonymous mremap growth
ART condition-variable startup required futex requeue
ART Signal Catcher required synchronous signal waiting

diagnostic_history.art-requeue-stderr: exit 127: sigwait ENOSYS; Java markers interleaved with abort output, explicitly INCOMPLETE

diagnostic_logger.scope: interposes Android log sink via LD_PRELOAD only in the two retained stderr diagnostics; absent from passing runs

limitations: No framework, Activity/APK or graphics success claimed.
Signal metadata uses SI_KERNEL; sender records, realtime queues and process-directed routing need further work.
Resource limit queries support fixed STACK and NOFILE only; updates and stack auto-growth unsupported.
Proc stat accounting fields unavailable from the native process interface are zero.
mremap fixed growth, shared/file/device growth and DONTUNMAP unsupported.
runner_note: Existing local crosvm runner edits remove an unused serial-input option. The exact image and QEMU commands are retained; no serial input was supplied.
cleanup: Temporary per-run boot/rootfs images, staged runtime copies and dependency targets are removed after preserving these records and the verified kernel locally.
